Hi Gina — thanks for sending these over and for filling out the onboarding form. Received both attachments.

Next steps from Redwood (summary):
1) Bank validation: we prefer micro-deposits for ACH binding unless you can provide a bank letter on Prime Harbor letterhead. Micro-deposit timeline: typically 1-2 business days to post; we'll ask FinOps to watch for them and confirm.
2) PO mapping: please include the customer PO in the invoice field labeled "invoice.reference" or "Invoice Ref". We will map that to our PO pipeline. I attached a small CSV template (bank_details_template.csv) that lists the exact field names we use for import.
3) Remit formatting: we support a split-invoice model (invoice-level remittance + separate line-item tagging). If HarborTech prefers consolidated remits, let us know and we'll enable the "consolidated_remit" flag.

I've attached the CSV template and a sample PO mapping workbook (po-mapping-example.xlsx) for your finance team. Once you confirm micro-deposit or send a bank letter, we'll enable payment channel and schedule the initial ACH.

Looking at Redwood's side: Marissa, Priyom — can you add HarborTech to the staging payee list and approve micro-deposit watch? Also Jordan, when this is live, please ensure the invoice "Invoice Ref" routes to the payops PO matcher (HS-392017).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
